plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Geospatial Technology AAS' program page (Major Code: 4133A), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/agriculture-department/geospatial-technology/geospatial-technology-aas . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four semester tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals 15/14/15/16). TRUE award: Associate of Applied Science (page title 'Geospatial Technology AAS'). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester tables sum 15+14+15+16 = 60. Variable credit: 'AGRI 227 Agriculture Internship* 3-6 Credits' is modeled at 4 credits (in-range). Rationale: the printed Spring Sophomore total is 16 (2+4+3+7); modeling at the 3-credit minimum would sum the semester to 15 and the plan to 59, below the catalog's published 60-credit total - so 4 credits is the minimum value consistent with the official published totals. Choice slots: MATH GE / COMM GE are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice). PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Elective(s)' (student choice: 6+6+8+7 = 27 credits); the page requires a minimum of 26 credits of program electives for graduation, chosen from the Data Management and Analysis Pathway and/or the Field Spatial Data Acquisition Pathway printed on the page (27 meets the 26 minimum). Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or Corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
